title: A Map at the Mat
lines: A map is at the mat!
Tap, tap! Tam is at the map.
Sam, Pam, Tam sat at the map.

questions.ask: Who sat at the mat first?
questions.listenFor: Sam. This one is in the first line - if they are not sure, have them put a finger on line one and read it again rather than telling them.
A map. Listen for them finding it in line two. Reading the line out loud again is the answer, so let them do that.

questions.ask: Would you like to sit at the map with them? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason of their own - what they think is on the map, or who they would want with them.
